title: jmap-types: conditional-02 wire types, error-code consts, JmapError.extra
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C1. Crates: jmap-types. Size: S.

Implement docs/design/conditional.md §4 (draft-ietf-jmap-conditional-02 §2.1, §3, §3.3, §4.2, §4.3, §8.1-8.3; RFC 8620 §3.6.2). New module crate-jmap-types/src/conditional.rs: JMAP_CONDITIONAL_URI; ATOMIC_FAILURE = "atomicFailure" and CANNOT_APPLY_ATOMICALLY = "cannotApplyAtomically" as &str consts (decision 7, docs/design/DECISIONS.md: NOT MethodErrorType variants; MethodErrorType stays unchanged, the codes decode to Other like graph OPS_COMPACTED / scene CONTENT_POLICY); ConditionalCapability (non_exhaustive, flattened extra); IfUnchangedBy = BTreeMap<String, Option<PatchObject>> (String keys for #creation ids); ConditionalSetArgs {if_unchanged_by, atomic} + is_default(); AtomicFailure {not_created, not_updated, not_destroyed, extra} with not_restored()/with_not_restored() over extra (decision 6(b) stopgap). error.rs: add `extra: serde_json::Map` (flatten, skip if empty) to JmapError (non_exhaustive, additive; needed for §3.3 failed and §4.2 maps); update custom() and every in-crate constructor. Inherent constructors/readers in conditional.rs: JmapError::state_mismatch_failed(Vec<Id>), atomic_failure(AtomicFailure), cannot_apply_atomically(), failed(), atomic_failure_details(). Acceptance: tests per §10 jmap-types paragraph (capability {} round trip, example 5.1 error JSON verbatim + failed(), atomicFailure with three maps + notRestored, both codes decode to Other, decoded JmapError keeps unknown props, JmapError size unit test); public-api/jmap-types.txt regenerated (additions only); cargo test/clippy/doc clean.
